item.title: Version 1.14.0
item.description:
• Ready to Promote window (training copy): every record that's new or changed compared with your real data — car details, projects, invoices, documents not on a project — marked New or Changed, with Open to check or fix it and Promote for each, or Promote All… (one backup first). Records that can't be promoted as they are (a name or invoice number used by a different record) are listed under Needs Fixing. Open it from the orange badge, which now shows the count ("TRAINING COPY · 3 TO PROMOTE"), or File ▸ Training Copy ▸ Review and Promote… (⇧⌘P). Checked every 15 seconds and right after each change the agent makes.
  • Claude chats (MCP server 1.11.0): new promotion_status tool, so the agent can tell you what's ready to promote and what needs fixing.

item.title: Version 1.13.0
item.description:
• Invoices can be promoted on their own (e.g. parts bought for stock, not on any project): the invoice page in the training copy shows Promote to Real Data…, or Promote Changes… when it was changed since. It brings the invoice, its supplier, lines and scanned file, and any new part records; an invoice number already used by a different record in your real data stops it.
  • Promoting a car also takes its new or changed invoices; the car shows Matches Real Data only when those are in your real data too.

item.title: Version 1.12.0
item.description:
• Promote Changes…: a project that's already in your real data but was changed in the training copy (its details, its parts' quantities, dates or costs, new purchases, documents) now shows Promote Changes… instead of "In Real Data". Promoting updates the real project to match, and brings along the invoices its parts were bought on (supplier, lines and file) and any new part records — nothing is added twice. Promoting a car includes its changed projects too.
  • Project parts: the Date Installed column is shown and can be edited right in the row (also in "Edit Quantities and Date…").
  • Claude chats (MCP server 1.10.0): new preview_project_part_update to change a part already on a project (install date, installed or needed quantity, from my stock, unit cost).

item.title: Version 1.11.0
item.description:
• Cars have an Odometer setting (Kilometres or Miles). Every mileage on a car's records (at purchase, projects, documents, current mileage) is in its unit and shown that way ("38,944 mi") in the car page, banner, Projects list, history and report.
  • Claude chats (MCP server 1.9.0) see each car's unit, are told to enter readings exactly as shown (never converted), and can set a car's odometer unit. Promoting a car carries its unit.
  • iCloud: the new field was added to the iCloud schema before this release.

item.title: Version 1.10.8
item.description:
• Promote to Real Data… on a car now takes everything about it the real data doesn't have yet, in one go: changed details, its new projects (e.g. "before you owned it" history, with their parts and documents) and its documents that aren't on a project (Carfax, ownership papers…). One backup first; the result lists what came across and anything that couldn't.
  • The car shows Matches Real Data only when its details and its whole history are in your real data.

item.title: Version 1.10.7
item.description: • On the training copy, Promote to Real Data… shows only when there's something to promote. A project already in your real data shows a green In Real Data mark instead; a car whose details already match shows Matches Real Data. (Read from your real data, read-only.)

item.title: Version 1.10.6
item.description: • Double-click a car, part, invoice or supplier (like a project) to open it in its own window; right-click also offers Open in New Window. New Car and Supplier windows; the invoice window shows the document beside it.

item.title: Version 1.10.5
item.description: • Promote to Real Data… now promotes straight away and you stay on the training copy: the app opens your real data beside it (with iCloud sync as usual, so the change uploads right away), backs it up, saves the project or car details and shows the result. No switching and nothing to remember.

item.title: Version 1.10.4
item.description: • Promote no longer switches to your real data. You stay on the training copy; the promoted project or car details wait and are saved into your real data the next time you open it (backup first, then the result is shown). Promoting the same record again before then replaces the waiting copy.

item.title: Version 1.10.3
item.description: • Project, Car and Supplier pages scroll when the window is too short, so the header (and its Promote to Real Data… button) is never cut off. With room to spare, the parts table / history still fills the window. (Part and Invoice pages already scrolled.)

item.title: Version 1.10.2
item.description:
• MCP server 1.8.0, matching how you train the agent: on the training copy it saves without asking you in the chat, then tells you exactly what it changed; you review in the app and ask for more or promote it yourself. Changes to real data still need your yes in the chat.
  • New app_status tool: the agent checks that the app is open on the training copy before changing anything (and is told to stop if it isn't).

item.title: Version 1.10.1
item.description: • MCP server 1.7.1: clearer guidance for the agent. It saves only to the training copy (after your yes in the chat), you review its work in the app, and promotion to the real data is yours, with Promote to Real Data… in the app. The chat promotion tools are hidden unless turned on (CAR_PROJECTS_PROMOTE=on).

item.title: Version 1.10.0
item.description:
• Projects: Description is now Purpose (why the project: the problem or goal); existing text stays there. New Outcome (Met, Partly Met, Not Met, Too Early to Tell) with a Why explanation, shown once a project has started, and a Notes field for everything else (work log, observations, specs).
  • Projects list: new Outcome column (hover for purpose and outcome). Car history and the car report show them too.
  • Claude chats (MCP server 1.7.0) read and write purpose, outcome and notes; previews warn when a change would replace existing text. Promote to Real Data carries them.
  • iCloud: the new fields were added to the iCloud schema before this release.

item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description: • Promote to Real Data… button on a project and on a car while the training copy is open. After you confirm, the app switches to your real data, backs it up and saves the project (its parts and documents) or the car's details there, then shows the result with a button back to the training copy. Parts are matched to your real parts by part number; a project already in your real data is never added twice; a part installed from stock that your real data doesn't have stops the promotion (enter its invoice first). A promotion not picked up within an hour is discarded.

item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
• A car's mileage field is now Mileage at purchase, beside the purchase date. New Current mileage on the car shows the latest odometer reading from its projects and documents (with where it came from); the car's banner and report use it.
  • Claude chats can correct a car's purchase date, mileage at purchase, trim or VIN (MCP server 1.6.0: preview_car_update, old → new, saved after your yes). preview_promote_car copies those details from the training copy to the real data. The app refuses a car change if the car was edited after the preview.
  • The MCP server's list_cars reports mileage at purchase and current mileage.

item.title: Version 1.7.7
item.description:
• The toolbar's TRAINING COPY badge is now a single orange capsule with its text, with no grey circle around it.
  • The training copy's window titles say TRAINING COPY once, no longer also "TEST DATABASE"; the About box says TRAINING COPY too.

item.title: Version 1.7.6
item.description: • The main window shows TRAINING COPY as an orange badge in the toolbar (click it for Return to Real Data) instead of a bar across the top, which covered the start of the sidebar. Other windows keep the orange bar.

item.title: Version 1.7.5
item.description:
• TRAINING COPY bar in orange across the top of every window while the training copy is open, with a Return to Real Data button; window titles say "TRAINING COPY" instead of "TEST DATABASE".
  • Fixed: Open Training Copy reopened the app on the real data. The choice of database is now remembered in the app's settings, so it holds however the app is opened (including after an update), until you return to real data.

item.title: Version 1.7.4
item.description: • File ▸ Training Copy: Make Fresh Training Copy…, Open Training Copy and Return to Real Data, right in the app. The app copies its own data, so macOS needs no extra permission (no Terminal, no Full Disk Access). Your real data is only read; the training copy never syncs.

item.title: Version 1.7.3
item.description:
• Promote a project from training to your real data: once a project (details, parts and documents) is right in the training copy, ask the agent to promote it. It previews exactly what your real data would get, parts matched by part number; after your yes, and with the app open on your real data, it is saved there. A project with the same name already in your real data is refused, so nothing is entered twice.
  • A planned project (Not Started) no longer needs a date; planned parts are shown as "needed, not installed yet".
  • A save only goes ahead while the app is open on that same database; nothing waits in a queue to land later.

item.title: Version 1.7.2
item.description:
• Safe training for Claude agents: the app now carries the car-projects MCP server and training.sh (inside the app, Contents/Resources/mcp-server), so every Mac with the app has them and updates keep them current. training.sh refresh copies your real data to a training copy, open opens the app on it (TEST DATABASE in every title), real goes back.
  • The MCP server can use the training copy (CAR_PROJECTS_DATABASE=training) and can be made read-only (CAR_PROJECTS_WRITE=off). Every preview and save says which database it is using.
  • A test or training copy can never sync to iCloud in installed builds, so nothing done in one can reach your real data.

item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
• Sync diagnostics: a small log (Diagnostics/sync.log next to the database) of iCloud notification registration, notifications received, sync events and app activation, to find out why changes from another Mac arrive only when the app is brought to the front.
  • The first version installed with Check for Updates….

item.title: Version 1.7
item.description:
• Check for Updates… in the Car Projects Manager menu, and an automatic check once a day. Updates download and install from inside the app (no more "downloaded from the Internet" question), and are only accepted when signed with the app's update key, Developer ID signed and notarized.
  • Includes 1.6.2: iCloud changes from your other Mac arrive in the background.
